title: Christina Aguilera Strips All the Way Down, Poses Nude for Sultry Bathtub Photo
text:
Christina Aguilera Poses Nude in Bathtub Instagram Selfie Photo 
 E!'s The Golden Life
 Watch Episode 2 Now! News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Christina Aguilera Strips All the Way Down, Poses Nude for Sultry Bathtub Photo
 Christina Aguilera dropped jaws with a selfie on Instagram where she stripped all the way down in the bathtub. 
 By Olivia Evans Oct 29, 2026 12:56 PM | Updated 22 hours ago Tags Christina Aguilera Celebrities Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Christina Aguilera Debuts Micro Bangs on PDA-Filled Date Night With Matthew Rutler Christina Aguilera  fans are certainly feeling this moment. 
 The Grammy winner dropped jaws in a recent social media post, stripping all the way down in her bathtub with only ghost emojis covering her breasts.
 Alongside the steamy selfie shared to Instagram Oct. 28 , Aguilera teased, “Last looks before Xtinaween.”
 And while words can’t bring Aguilera down, her fans were certainly building her up in the comments. 
 “She’s the moment,” one fan wrote, “She’s an icon she’s a star.” Another joked, “That wasn’t an earthquake it was just me falling to my knees.”
 Meanwhile, another fan admitted, “Hold on, let me pick my jaw up from the floor.”
 Aguilera’s stylist  Chris Horan  also commented—possibly teasing her upcoming Halloween costume, as he has assisted the “Lady Marmalade” singer with her past creations. As he cheekily wrote, “I ain’t ‘fraid of those ghosts.”
 For Aguilera’s part, she has expressed in the last few years that she’s finally letting her inner genie out of the bottle—and not letting anyone make the calls in her self-love journey. 
 read Christina Aguilera and Daughter Summer, 12, Are Picture Perfect in Rare Photo “This is a reminder to everyone that you are your OWN STORYTELLER in your OWN LIFE,” Aguilera wrote in a January 2025 Instagram post . “No one else can dictate who you are. No one deserves an explanation. I am evolved enough to know that nothing comes easy and no one is perfect.”
 The 45-year-old emphasized that she’s over listening to the critics—because they’ll always say  something . 
 “Everyone will judge you,” she continued. “No matter WHAT you do and/or what you don’t do. Acceptance comes with accepting yourself first and the difficult journey it takes sometimes to get there.”
 What Aguilera wants…is for all of her fans to work on loving themselves, too. 
 Christina Aguilera/Instagram “I celebrate everyone taking the time to put one step in front of the next everyday in order to build the next version of themselves for the better,” she continued. “Allowing yourself grace, patience and respect.”
